create_logger: create a default Acme logger that writes to terminal and CSV using make_default_logger
restore_checkpoint: restore model state from a TensorFlow checkpoint file using restore_from_checkpoint
generate_checkpoints: generate checkpoint states from a directory using get_checkpoint_generator
flatten_metrics: flatten nested metrics dictionary into a flat dict using flatten_metrics
validate_config: validate an ml_collections ConfigDict against launch arguments using validate_config
